# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-1] # Create a Resume with Resume Builder
_Last updated: Mar 7, 2025, 4:17 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
The HackerRank Resume Builder is a powerful tool that helps you create a professional resume in just a few steps. It allows you to showcase your skills, achievements, and certifications to stand out to potential employers.
## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

[1995877061-introduction-to-hackerrank-community-4] - **Resume builder:** Create a professional resume using the integrated resume builder that showcases your skills, achievements, and certifications.
- **Job matching:** Receive personalized job recommendations based on your skills, certifications, and career preferences.
**Developer community**
- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-8] Ensure your resume aligns with job descriptions before submitting it. Use **Resume Matcher** to compare your resume against job requirements.
To use Resume Matcher:
1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.
2.  Click **+ Add Job**.
3.  Paste the job posting link. The system retrieves job details and checks if your resume includes relevant skills, experience, and keywords.

[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

You can add or remove attendees prior to the interview and still be able to use the same link.

The HackerRank Resume Builder is a powerful tool that helps you create a professional resume in just a few steps. It allows you to showcase your skills, achievements, and certifications to stand out to potential employers.
## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

[1995877061-introduction-to-hackerrank-community-4] - **Resume builder:** Create a professional resume using the integrated resume builder that showcases your skills, achievements, and certifications.
- **Job matching:** Receive personalized job recommendations based on your skills, certifications, and career preferences.
**Developer community**
- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-8] Ensure your resume aligns with job descriptions before submitting it. Use **Resume Matcher** to compare your resume against job requirements.
To use Resume Matcher:
1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.
2.  Click **+ Add Job**.
3.  Paste the job posting link. The system retrieves job details and checks if your resume includes relevant skills, experience, and keywords.
4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

## Accepting with card present
If you accept cards in person, there are steps you need to take.
### Swipe the card
Swipe the card through a magnetic card reader, insert the card into a chip-reading device, or wave the card in front of a Visa payWave contactless payment terminal to request the transaction authorisation.

Subject: Personal Data Use
Issue: I am allowing Claude to use my data to improve the models, how long will the data be used for?
Company: Claude
Request Type: invalid
Product Area: technical

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

Ticket:
Subject: Visa card minimum spend
Issue: i am in US Virgin Islands and the merchant is saying i have to spend minimum 10$ on my VISA card, why so?
Company: Visa
Request Type: product_issue
Product Area: account/billing

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[support-17] ### Merchants
### I have concerns about a place where I used my Visa card. What should I do?
If you have concerns involving a merchant, you can take action immediately by [filling out this form.](/Forms/visa-rules.html)

2. Find the member you want to reassign.
3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.
4. Select Chat or Chat + Claude Code.

## My Team plan access is no longer active and I want to resubscribe.
An organization owner can resubscribe for Team plan access by navigating to **[Organization settings > Billing](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/billing)**.

[13393991-purchase-and-manage-seats-on-enterprise-plans-12] 1. Go to **[Organization settings > Organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/organization).**
2. Find the member you want to unassign.
3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.
4. Select "Unassigned."
To restore their access, repeat the process and select “Enterprise seat.”
> **Note:** Unassigned members remain part of your organization but cannot use Claude until they're assigned to a seat.

#### I am unable to invite candidates to take a HackerRank test what is the problem?
The email ID you have used with your Teamtailor account should be the same as the email ID associated with the HackerRank account, which also possesses a Recruiter license in HackerRank.
#### What type of license do I need in HackerRank to use the integration?

[7795424803-ibm-kenexa-brassring---hackerrank-tests-integration-2] The below diagram describes the workflow of the BrassRing and HackerRank integration for recruiters. Recruiters will move a candidate into a custom HackerRank Test status. Upon entering this status, BrassRing will dispatch a payload to HackerRank via the candidate Export API. HackerRank will then send a test invitation to the candidate. After the candidate has completed the test and HackerRank has graded the test, HackerRank will send the results back to BrassRing via the Form Import API.

[5157311476-pause-subscription-19] ### Extending the Pause Period
You can extend the pause period even during an active pause.
- Navigate to the **Billing** page and click the **Cancel Subscription** button.

[5157311476-pause-subscription-2] 1.  You must have an active subscription that started at least 30 days ago.
- This includes accounts in a renewal grace period (7 days) due to a late recurring payment.
2.  You must have a **monthly subscription** for one of the following plans:
- Individual Monthly - Basic
- Interview Monthly
### How to Pause Your Subscription
Follow these steps to pause your subscription:
- **Access Subscription Settings**

This feature enables you to resume your subscription whenever needed, ensuring flexibility and uninterrupted access when required.

You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.

2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

The HackerRank Resume Builder is a powerful tool that helps you create a professional resume in just a few steps. It allows you to showcase your skills, achievements, and certifications to stand out to potential employers.
## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

[1995877061-introduction-to-hackerrank-community-4] - **Resume builder:** Create a professional resume using the integrated resume builder that showcases your skills, achievements, and certifications.
- **Job matching:** Receive personalized job recommendations based on your skills, certifications, and career preferences.
**Developer community**
- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-8] Ensure your resume aligns with job descriptions before submitting it. Use **Resume Matcher** to compare your resume against job requirements.

1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.

4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[9157064719-payments-and-billing-faqs-1] # Subscriptions, Payments, and Billing FAQs Mock interviews Subscription plans
_Last updated: Nov 12, 2025, 4:42 PM (Last updated 5 months ago)_
# Mock interviews
**What happens to my mock interview credits if I merge accounts?**
Mock interview credits cannot be transferred and stay on the account where they were purchased. We recommend using them before merging accounts.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.

## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.

4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

_Last updated: Mar 7, 2025, 4:17 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
The HackerRank Resume Builder is a powerful tool that helps you create a professional resume in just a few steps. It allows you to showcase your skills, achievements, and certifications to stand out to potential employers.
## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

[1995877061-introduction-to-hackerrank-community-4] - **Resume builder:** Create a professional resume using the integrated resume builder that showcases your skills, achievements, and certifications.
- **Job matching:** Receive personalized job recommendations based on your skills, certifications, and career preferences.
**Developer community**
- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-8] Ensure your resume aligns with job descriptions before submitting it. Use **Resume Matcher** to compare your resume against job requirements.
To use Resume Matcher:
1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.
2.  Click **+ Add Job**.
3.  Paste the job posting link. The system retrieves job details and checks if your resume includes relevant skills, experience, and keywords.
4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.

In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

Recruiters will move a candidate into a custom HackerRank Test status. Upon entering this status, BrassRing will dispatch a payload to HackerRank via the candidate Export API. 3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.

[6477583642-ensuring-a-great-candidate-experience-2] This guide explains how to prepare candidates for success, manage candidate support, and handle candidate issues efficiently and fairly.
**Important Note: **
HackerRank does not participate in hiring decisions. The HackerRank team is not authorized to share test results, reschedule assessments or interviews, grant testing accommodations, or modify your hiring workflow.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[13393991-purchase-and-manage-seats-on-enterprise-plans-20] 1. Go to **[Organization settings > Organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/organization).**

[12997503-team-plan-billing-faqs-10] Please click on the message icon in the bottom right of our Help Center to contact our Support team and share the relevant documentation.
## My Team plan access is no longer active and I want to resubscribe.
An organization owner can resubscribe for Team plan access by navigating to **[Organization settings > Billing](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/billing)**.

[13393991-purchase-and-manage-seats-on-enterprise-plans-12] 1. Go to **[Organization settings > Organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/organization).**
2. Find the member you want to unassign.
3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.
4. Select "Unassigned."
To restore their access, repeat the process and select “Enterprise seat.”
> **Note:** Unassigned members remain part of your organization but cannot use Claude until they're assigned to a seat.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

To use Resume Matcher:
1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.

4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

## My Team plan access is no longer active and I want to resubscribe.
An organization owner can resubscribe for Team plan access by navigating to **[Organization settings > Billing](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/billing)**.

[13393991-purchase-and-manage-seats-on-enterprise-plans-12] 1. Go to **[Organization settings > Organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/organization).**
2. Find the member you want to unassign.
3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.
4. Select "Unassigned."
To restore their access, repeat the process and select “Enterprise seat.”
> **Note:** Unassigned members remain part of your organization but cannot use Claude until they're assigned to a seat.

[7795424803-ibm-kenexa-brassring---hackerrank-tests-integration-2] The below diagram describes the workflow of the BrassRing and HackerRank integration for recruiters. Recruiters will move a candidate into a custom HackerRank Test status. Upon entering this status, BrassRing will dispatch a payload to HackerRank via the candidate Export API. HackerRank will then send a test invitation to the candidate. After the candidate has completed the test and HackerRank has graded the test, HackerRank will send the results back to BrassRing via the Form Import API.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.

2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.

## Creating a resume with Resume Builder

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.

In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.

Subject: Visa card minimum spend
Issue: i am in US Virgin Islands and the merchant is saying i have to spend minimum 10$ on my VISA card, why so?

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

[support-17] ### Merchants

Recruiters will move a candidate into a custom HackerRank Test status. Upon entering this status, BrassRing will dispatch a payload to HackerRank via the candidate Export API. # Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

## Creating a resume with Resume Builder

Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.

[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

Subject: Visa card minimum spend

Company: Visa

Product Area: account/billing

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

Recruiters will move a candidate into a custom HackerRank Test status. Upon entering this status, BrassRing will dispatch a payload to HackerRank via the candidate Export API. # Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

[2837093779-standardizing-interviews-using-templates-30] 4.  Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.

[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.

## My Team plan access is no longer active and I want to resubscribe.

[13393991-purchase-and-manage-seats-on-enterprise-plans-12] 1. Go to **[Organization settings > Organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/organization).**
2. Find the member you want to unassign.
3. Click the dropdown under **Seat Type**.

# Removing user access from an interview template
You can remove access for any user or team from an interview template.
To remove access:
1.  Go to **Interviews \> Templates**.
2.  Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3.  In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.

The HackerRank Resume Builder is a powerful tool that helps you create a professional resume in just a few steps. It allows you to showcase your skills, achievements, and certifications to stand out to potential employers.
## Creating a resume with Resume Builder
You can create a resume in one of the following ways:

[1995877061-introduction-to-hackerrank-community-4] - **Resume builder:** Create a professional resume using the integrated resume builder that showcases your skills, achievements, and certifications.
- **Job matching:** Receive personalized job recommendations based on your skills, certifications, and career preferences.
**Developer community**
- **Interactive discussion forums**: Connect with a global network of developers, exchange insights, and collaborate on projects.

[9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder-8] Ensure your resume aligns with job descriptions before submitting it. Use **Resume Matcher** to compare your resume against job requirements.
To use Resume Matcher:
1.  Select **Resume Matcher**.
2.  Click **+ Add Job**.
3.  Paste the job posting link. The system retrieves job details and checks if your resume includes relevant skills, experience, and keywords.
4.  Select **Add Another Job** to compare multiple job descriptions.

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-1] **Can I update the name on my certificate?**
Yes. You can update the name on your certificate only once per account.
When you update your name, the change applies to all your certificates. After you update it, you cannot change it again.
To update the name on your certificate:

[8941367927-certifications-faqs-3] 1.  Open your certificate page.
2.  In the **Full Name** field, enter the name you want to display.
3.  Click **Regenerate Certificate**.
4.  In the confirmation dialog, click **Update Name**.
The platform updates your certificate with the new name.
**Why did I not receive my certificate after completing the test?**
If you have not received your certificate, follow these steps:

[2426927743-how-to-rename-a-test-3] Once you have completed changing the test name, you can save it by clicking on the green tick icon. Alternatively, you can choose not to save it by clicking on the close icon.
You can also change the name in the **Settings** tab, under **General.**

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[11174108-about-the-development-partner-program-5] - Under the Development Partner Program, only your Claude Code input and output tokens from the first-party Claude API are provided to us. Data sharing does not apply to Claude apps or API calls unrelated to Claude Code, when using our commercial products.
- Your data will be stored securely for up to two years, and data used for model training will not be associated with other customer information.
- This setting applies to all members in your organization.
- All members in your organization will be informed that you have enrolled into the program.
- You can leave the program at any time, but previously provided data will be stored for up to 2 years.

[10440198-configure-custom-data-retention-controls-for-enterprise-plans-3] Custom data retention controls allow organizations to manage how long Claude stores conversation and project data. This article explains how to set up and manage data retention periods for your organization.
## How data retention works
Data retention is based on the last observed activity:

[8325621-i-would-like-to-input-sensitive-data-into-my-chats-with-claude-who-can-view-my-conversations-3] - We automatically de-link your data from your user ID (like your email address) before any review.
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training.
- We will use tools and processes derived from our work on [privacy-preserving analysis tools](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio) to filter or obfuscate sensitive data. In addition to that, our pioneering research in post-training techniques helps to minimize the amount of personal data included in Claude’s outputs.
- Your data is used solely to make Claude better for everyone - we do not use such personal data to contact people, build profiles about them, to try to sell or market anything to them, or to sell the information itself to any third party.
- You maintain full control and can adjust your [privacy settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls) at any time.
- Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your [Privacy Settings](https://claude.ai/settings/data-privacy-controls). [Learn more](https://support.anthropic.com/en/articles/12260368-using-incognito-chats) about incognito chats.

Ticket:
Subject: Visa card minimum spend
Issue: i am in US Virgin Islands and the merchant is saying i have to spend minimum 10$ on my VISA card, why so?
Company: Visa
Request Type: product_issue
Product Area: account/billing

Retrieved Support Excerpts:
[support-18] In general, a merchant is not permitted to establish a minimum or maximum amount for a Visa transaction. However, exceptions apply in the USA and US territories – like Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam. In those locations, and only for credit cards, a merchant may require a minimum transaction amount of US\$10. If you encounter an issue where a merchant has refused to accept your Visa card on the basis that the merchant requires a minimum or maximum amount on a Visa debit card, or requires that the purchase amount on a credit card is greater than US\$10, please notify your Visa card issuer.
